acceptance.text: Visible anonymous route redirects to Admin login; authenticated screen loads canonical paths, filters and detail; inspect Console and Network and record each METHOD+PATH independently.
At 390px the screen has no document-level horizontal overflow and every wide table column remains reachable within its own horizontal scroller.
Backend rejects anonymous and roleless Admin access; authorized readers can read; only authorized content writers can mutate.

CRUD and workflow actions pass through the visible UI on a unique disposable learning path, persistence and audit are checked after refresh, and every disposable row/audit record is deleted and verified absent.
No canonical vocabulary, kanji or grammar rows are created, edited or deleted; canonical learning paths are not mutated.

spec.expected_behavior: Verify all visible paths and per-method API contracts, enforce content.read on reads and content.write plus CSRF on mutations, preserve published authored content and use only disposable fixtures for CRUD.
spec.observed_behavior: Learning paths routes currently appear in the Admin adminGuard group without method-level content permissions; frontend screen exposes filters, detail, create/edit and reason-based transitions.
